放完所有 run 后剩下的格子只能补 EMPTY，否则候选长度对不上线长。
run 贴在一起不留空会让两个 run 合并成一个更长的 run，直接违反 clue 的分段。
optionExplanations_en: Runs must go in the order the clue lists them; placing them out of order produces layouts that don't match the clue.
The gap between adjacent runs is part of what a clue means; skip it and the candidate stops being valid.
Whatever is left after placing every run must be padded with EMPTY, or the candidate's length won't match the line.
Letting runs touch with no gap merges them into one longer run, which breaks the clue's separate-segment meaning.

scenario: line generator 正在决定当前 run 的最晚起点，必须给后续所有 run 和间隔留下空间。
scenario_en: The line generator is choosing the latest start for the current run while leaving room for all later runs and required gaps.
q: 哪段公式最符合文章里的 `latest` 含义？
q_en: Which formula best matches the article's meaning of latest?
options: latest = length - (sum(clues[run_idx:]) + (n_runs - run_idx - 1))
latest = length - sum(clues[run_idx:]) - (n_runs - run_idx)
latest = length - (clues[run_idx] + n_runs - run_idx - 1)
latest = pos + sum(clues[run_idx:]) - (n_runs - run_idx - 1)
options_en: latest = length - (sum(clues[run_idx:]) + (n_runs - run_idx - 1))
latest = length - sum(clues[run_idx:]) - (n_runs - run_idx)
latest = length - (clues[run_idx] + n_runs - run_idx - 1)
latest = pos + sum(clues[run_idx:]) - (n_runs - run_idx - 1)
why: `latest` 是当前 run 最右能开始的位置，右侧仍要容纳当前及后续 run 和它们之间的强制 gap。
why_en: The latest start reserves enough cells for the current and remaining runs plus mandatory gaps.
whenOtherWins: 如果你用组合分配 slack 的写法，可以不显式命名 latest，但必须表达同样的空间约束。
tradeoff: 显式算 latest 上界（直观但要对齐 off-by-one）vs 用组合方式直接分配 slack（更抽象但少写边界判断）
codeSample:
latest = length - (sum(clues[run_idx:]) + (n_runs - run_idx - 1))
for start in range(pos, latest + 1):
    # start 越大，留给后续 run 和间隔的空间越少
    place_run_at(start)
optionExplanations: 右侧要留给当前及后续所有 run 加上它们之间的强制间隔，这个式子正好算出这段空间。
多减了一个 gap 名额，起点被逼得比实际合法范围更靠左，会漏掉本该成立的候选。
只减了当前 run 的长度，忘了后面还有其它 run 和间隔要占位，起点会算得偏右越界。
用 `pos` 做加法反向推导，方向和符号都搞反了，算不出合法的最晚起点。
optionExplanations_en: The space that must stay reserved on the right is the current-plus-remaining runs plus their mandatory gaps, and this formula computes exactly that.
It subtracts one gap too many, pushing the start further left than necessary and missing otherwise-legal candidates.
It only accounts for the current run's length and forgets the later runs and gaps, so the start ends up too far right.
Adding from pos reverses the direction entirely, so it can't produce a valid latest-start position.

termDefinitions.meaning: line generator 里当前 run 允许的最晚起始列，需给后续 run 和间隔留空间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: latest is the rightmost start column a run may take while leaving room for later runs and gaps.

scenario: 把逐格搜索换成每步直接放一整行合法候选后，你要说清最直接的收益在哪。
scenario_en: After switching from cell-by-cell search to placing one full legal row per step, name the immediate payoff.
q: row-by-row 回溯相比 cell-by-cell 的直接收益是什么？
q_en: What is the direct benefit of row-by-row backtracking over cell-by-cell search?
options: 永远不用再检查任何列约束
每个分支放入的是已经满足行 clue 的整行候选
直接把 NP-complete 问题变成线性时间问题
从此不再需要任何形式的回溯
options_en: You never need to check column constraints again.
Every branch places a whole row candidate that already satisfies its row clue.
It turns an NP-complete problem into a linear-time one.
It removes the need for backtracking entirely.
why: 行约束在候选生成时已经满足，搜索时主要用列约束过滤这些行候选。
why_en: Row backtracking places only row layouts that already satisfy their row clues, then uses columns to prune.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一类没有已知多项式时间解法、但验证一个解很快的问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NP-complete problems have no known polynomial-time solver even though checking a candidate solution is fast.

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述一行/列上从左到右（或从上到下）filled run 长度的整数列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A clue is the ordered list of filled-run lengths required on one row or column.

optionExplanations: 列约束仍要用来过滤行候选，只是从「逐格判断」变成「整行判断」，不是不再检查。
行候选在生成阶段就已经满足行 clue，搜索只需要再用列约束筛掉不合适的行。
复杂度类别没变，只是把树的深度从格子数降到行数，仍然可能是指数级。
行与行之间仍要试错撤销，只是回溯的粒度变粗了，不是取消回溯。
optionExplanations_en: Column constraints still filter row candidates — the check moves from per-cell to per-row, it doesn't disappear.
By the time a row candidate is generated it's already a valid layout for its own clue, so the search step just uses columns to weed out bad ones.
The complexity class doesn't change; it only shrinks tree depth from cell count to row count, which can still be exponential.
Rows still get tried and undone between each other; the backtracking granularity changes, it isn't removed.

scenario: row-by-row solver 刚放完第 k 行，每列只有前 k 个格子已知，要判断能否继续往下递归。
scenario_en: The row-by-row solver just placed row k, so every column has only its first k cells known, and it must decide whether to recurse deeper.
q: row-by-row 中的 column consistency 为什么必须支持「部分列」？
q_en: Why must column consistency in row-by-row backtracking handle partial columns?
options: 因为回溯只填了前若干行，列还没完整结束
因为列 clue 不重要
因为行候选都是随机的
因为部分列必须完全等于最终 clue
options_en: Because backtracking has only placed the first several rows, so the column is not finished yet.
Because column clues do not matter.
Because row candidates are random.
Because a partial column must already equal the final clue exactly.
why: 放完第 k 行时，列只有前 k 个格子已知；正在增长的尾部 run 只能要求不超过对应 clue，而不能要求已经相等。
why_en: Column checks are partial because only the placed rows are known, so an open trailing run may still grow.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  PartialCol[Partial column] --> Closed[Closed runs match prefix]
  PartialCol --> Open[Open run not too long]
  PartialCol --> Future[Leave room for rest]
  Closed --> OK[still possible]
  Open --> OK
  Future --> OK

termDefinitions.meaning: 一行/列里连续被 filled 的一段格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A run is a contiguous block of filled cells on a line.

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述一行/列上从左到右（或从上到下）filled run 长度的整数列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A clue is the ordered list of filled-run lengths required on one row or column.

termDefinitions.meaning: 格子状态之一：该格尚未被确定。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UNKNOWN is the cell state meaning the cell has not been determined yet.

optionExplanations: 只放了前 k 行时，列里还有格子没填，检查当然只能是「部分」而不是「完整」。
列 clue 恰恰是传播和搜索能剪枝的关键信息，说它不重要正好说反了。
行候选都是满足行 clue 的合法布局，不是随机生成的，这个前提本身就错了。
尾部还在增长的 run 只需要不超长，过早要求它等于最终 clue 会误杀合法分支。
optionExplanations_en: With only the first k rows placed, some column cells are still unfilled, so the check can only be partial, not final.
Column clues are exactly what lets propagation and search prune branches — calling them unimportant gets it backwards.
Row candidates are valid layouts that already satisfy the row clue, not random guesses, so this premise is simply wrong.
An open trailing run only needs to stay within length; demanding exact equality too early wrongly kills valid branches.

scenario: row-by-row 只填了前 k 行就做列检查：判得太严会剪掉合法解，太松就没有剪枝力。
scenario_en: The row-by-row solver checks columns with only k rows filled: too strict prunes valid solutions, too loose prunes nothing.
q: 关于部分列一致性，哪些判断正确？（多选）
q_en: Which statements about partial column consistency are correct? (Choose all that apply.)
options: 已关闭的 run 必须与 clue 前缀完全匹配
正在尾部增长的 run 不能超过下一个 clue run 的长度
如果 completed run 数量超过 clue 数量，应判 false
部分列中任何 FILLED 都立即要求整列 solved
options_en: A closed run must exactly match the clue's prefix so far.
An open trailing run must not exceed the length of the next clue run.
If the number of completed runs exceeds the clue count, the column is invalid.
Any FILLED cell in a partial column immediately requires the whole column to be solved.
why: 部分检查区分关闭 run 和开放 run；开放 run 还能继续增长，但不能越过目标长度。
why_en: A partial column is valid when closed runs match the clue prefix and any open trailing run can still fit the next clue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一行/列里连续被 filled 的一段格子。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A run is a contiguous block of filled cells on a line.

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述一行/列上从左到右（或从上到下）filled run 长度的整数列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A clue is the ordered list of filled-run lengths required on one row or column.

termDefinitions.meaning: 格子状态之一：该格已确定被涂色。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FILLED is the cell state meaning the cell is confirmed colored in.

optionExplanations: 已经被 EMPTY 断开的 run 是「关闭」的，它必须和 clue 里对应位置的长度完全一致。
还没被断开的尾部 run 随时可能继续变长，只要求它不超过下一个 clue 值即可，先别判死。
关闭的 run 数一旦超过 clue 里的 run 个数，说明多出来的这些不可能再合法，应立即判 false。
部分列里出现 FILLED 只是又确定了一个格子，不代表整列已经填完，不该要求立刻 solved。
optionExplanations_en: A run that's already closed off by an EMPTY must match its corresponding clue length exactly.
An open trailing run can still grow, so it only needs to stay within the next clue length, not match it yet.
Once closed runs outnumber the clue's run count, no valid layout can fit anymore, so the column should fail immediately.
One more FILLED cell in a partial column just adds information; it doesn't mean the whole column is already solved.

scenario: row-by-row 在第 k 行的所有候选都失败，准备回到上一层换一种第 k-1 行的布局。
scenario_en: Every candidate for row k has failed, so the row-by-row solver is about to go back up and try a different row k-1.
q: row-by-row 回溯在某一行所有候选失败后，为什么要把该行恢复成 UNKNOWN？
q_en: Why must row-by-row backtracking reset a row to UNKNOWN after all its candidates fail?
options: 避免父层或兄弟分支看到最后一次尝试留下的行状态
让这一行的 clue 从此永久失效
让 column consistency 之后永远返回 true
只是为了让打印出来的 grid 更美观
options_en: So the parent or sibling branch never sees the row state left by the last failed attempt.
So the row's clue permanently stops applying.
So column consistency always returns true afterward.
Purely to make the printed grid look nicer.
why: 回溯的父层可能还会尝试另一种上一行布局；当前行残留会污染后续列检查。
why_en: A failed row must be reset so sibling branches do not inherit stale cells from the last tried layout.

termDefinitions.meaning: 格子状态之一：该格尚未被确定。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UNKNOWN is the cell state meaning the cell has not been determined yet.

optionExplanations: 父层接下来会试这一行的下一个候选，如果不清空，残留状态会被误当成已确定格污染列检查。
重置成 UNKNOWN 只是清空这次尝试的痕迹，clue 本身从未失效过。
清空状态不会让检查逻辑失效，column consistency 该拒绝还是会拒绝。
这是正确性问题不是美观问题，残留状态真的会让兄弟分支算错。
optionExplanations_en: The parent will try this row's next candidate next, and leftover state would be mistaken for known cells, corrupting column checks.
Resetting to UNKNOWN just clears this attempt's marks; the row's clue was never disabled to begin with.
Clearing state doesn't break the check logic — column consistency still rejects invalid columns as it should.
This is a correctness fix, not cosmetics — leftover state genuinely makes sibling branches compute wrong results.

scenario: row-by-row 回溯里，每一行平均有 P 个满足行 clue 的合法候选，棋盘共有 r 行。
scenario_en: In row-by-row backtracking, each row has on average P valid candidates that satisfy its row clue, and the board has r rows.
q: 搜索叶子数量的上界最接近哪个表达式？
q_en: Which expression is the closest upper bound on the number of search leaves?
options: O(P^r)
O(r + c)
O(log P)
options_en: O(P to the r).
O(r plus c).
O(log P).
O(2 to the c).
why: 每一行选择一个候选，最坏情况下行与行之间无法剪枝，就会形成 P 的 r 次方组合。
why_en: Row backtracking has up to P to the r combinations when each of r rows can choose among P layouts.
optionExplanations: 每一行独立从 P 个候选里挑一个，r 行组合起来最坏就是 P 的 r 次方。
O(r+c) 是线性量级，完全没体现「每行独立选一个候选」带来的组合爆炸。
O(log P) 只在能对候选做二分之类操作时才成立，这里没有这种结构。
O(2^c) 描述的是按列逐格猜测的规模，不是这里按行选候选的组合方式。
optionExplanations_en: Each of r rows independently picks one of P candidates, so the worst-case combination is P raised to the r.
O(r plus c) is linear and completely misses the combinatorial blowup from each row picking independently.
O(log P) would only apply if candidates could be binary-searched somehow, which isn't the structure here.
O(2 to the c) describes per-cell column guessing, not this row-candidate combination model.

scenario: row-by-row 能在 5000ms 内过 10×10，但 15×15 又超时了，你要定位新的瓶颈。
scenario_en: Row-by-row clears 10x10 inside the 5000ms budget but times out again on 15x15, and you need to find the new bottleneck.
q: row-by-row 回溯为什么会在 15×15 上再次变慢？
q_en: Why does row-by-row backtracking become slow again on 15x15 puzzles?
options: 15×15 网格已经没办法生成任何行候选
15 长度中等 clue 常有成千候选，P^15 仍巨大
列 clue 在 15×15 上被完全忽略掉了
这时每一行都恰好只剩一个合法候选
options_en: A 15 by 15 grid can no longer generate any row candidates.
A mid-size length-15 clue often has thousands of candidates; P to the 15 stays huge.
Column clues are completely ignored on 15 by 15 grids.
Every row happens to have exactly one legal candidate at this size.
why: 按行减少了深度，但如果每行候选数很大，且列约束只用于拒绝已放置行，搜索空间仍会爆炸。
why_en: Row backtracking still explodes on larger grids when each row has thousands of possible layouts.

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述一行/列上从左到右（或从上到下）filled run 长度的整数列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A clue is the ordered list of filled-run lengths required on one row or column.

optionExplanations: 生成器在任何长度下都能枚举候选，15 长度一样能生成，只是数量变多了。
长度 15 的中等 clue 常常有成千上万种合法排布，就算深度只是 15 层，P^15 依然是天文数字。
列约束一直在用来过滤已放置的行，只是过滤速度跟不上候选数量的增长。
如果每行真只剩一个候选，搜索早就秒解了，慢正是因为候选数远不止一个。
optionExplanations_en: The generator can still enumerate candidates at any line length; length 15 just means more of them, not zero.
A mid-size length-15 clue often has thousands of valid layouts, so even at depth 15, P to the 15 is still astronomical.
Column constraints are still used to reject placed rows; they just can't filter fast enough against the growing candidate count.
If each row truly had only one candidate left, the search would finish instantly — the slowdown proves there are far more.

scenario: 行回溯已经能过 10×10，但 15×15 仍然超时；你希望同时利用行 clue 和列 clue，把能推出来的格子先填掉。
scenario_en: Row backtracking can pass 10x10 but still times out on 15x15; you want to use both row and column clues to fill cells that can be inferred first.
q: 应该升级成哪种策略？
q_en: Which strategy should you upgrade to?
options: 继续只按行回溯，但把候选按长度排序剪枝
同时维护行/列候选，先做约束传播，必要时再搜索
只维护列候选，行候选交给回溯自己猜
放弃候选列表，直接用 SAT 求解器整体求解
options_en: Keep row-only backtracking but sort candidates by length to prune.
Maintain row and column candidates together, propagate constraints first, and search only when needed.
Maintain only column candidates and let backtracking guess rows freely.
Drop candidate lists entirely and hand the whole puzzle to a SAT solver.
why: 传播把每条线的候选与已知格互相过滤，并提交所有候选都一致的强制格；搜索只作为推不动时的兜底。
why_en: Constraint propagation filters row and column candidates against known cells and fills forced cells before falling back to search.
whenOtherWins: 如果谜题极小，row-by-row 已经足够简单快速；大一些的约束题才值得维护双向候选。
tradeoff: 行列双向传播（推导优先，代价是维护两套候选）vs 单轴行回溯（简单但组合爆炸）
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Grid[Known grid] --> Rows[Filter row candidates]
  Grid --> Cols[Filter column candidates]
  Rows --> Forced[Forced cells]
  Cols --> Forced
  Forced --> Grid
optionExplanations: 排序只改变尝试顺序，候选组合总数没变，10×10 能过不代表 15×15 也能过。
当行列都能提供强约束、又能互相收缩对方候选时，先传播再搜索能把大片格子直接推出来，只在卡住时才猜。
只维护一半信息等于只做了半套传播，行仍然要靠盲猜，收益有限。
引入外部通用求解器绕开了手写行列推理，偏离了这道题要练习的传播逻辑。
optionExplanations_en: Sorting only changes try order, not the total combination count, so passing 10 by 10 says nothing about 15 by 15.
When both axes give strong constraints that can shrink each other's candidates, propagating first and searching only when stuck forces large regions directly.
Maintaining only one axis is half a propagation system — rows still get guessed blindly, so the benefit is limited.
Handing the whole thing to an external solver skips the hand-written row-column reasoning this problem is meant to practice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 反复用已知格过滤各线候选、推出强制格，直到没有新变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Propagation repeatedly filters line candidates against known cells and commits forced cells until nothing changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 描述一行/列上从左到右（或从上到下）filled run 长度的整数列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A clue is the ordered list of filled-run lengths required on one row or column.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给定 clue 和线长，枚举该线所有合法填法的函数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A line possibility generator enumerates every valid layout for a line given its clue and length.

scenario: 你要写传播版 solver，它必须在每轮之间保留足够状态才能继续收缩候选。
scenario_en: You're writing the propagation solver, and it has to carry enough state between rounds to keep shrinking the candidates.
q: 传播版 solver 需要同时维护哪些状态？（多选）
q_en: What state must a propagation-based solver maintain? (Choose all that apply.)
options: 当前 grid 的已知 UNKNOWN/FILLED/EMPTY
每一行剩余可能候选列表
每一列剩余可能候选列表
所有历史失败棋盘的完整列表
options_en: The grid's currently known UNKNOWN, FILLED, and EMPTY cells.
Each row's remaining candidate layout list.
Each column's remaining candidate layout list.
A full history list of every previously failed board.
why: 传播靠 grid 与行列候选互相收缩；历史失败棋盘不是核心状态，回溯栈自然保存分支。
why_en: The propagation solver maintains the grid plus remaining candidate layouts for every row and column.

termDefinitions.meaning: 格子状态之一：该格尚未被确定。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UNKNOWN is the cell state meaning the cell has not been determined yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 格子状态之一：该格已确定被涂色。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FILLED is the cell state meaning the cell is confirmed colored in.

termDefinitions.meaning: 格子状态之一：该格已确定为空白。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: EMPTY is the cell state meaning the cell is confirmed blank.

termDefinitions.meaning: 反复用已知格过滤各线候选、推出强制格，直到没有新变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Propagation repeatedly filters line candidates against known cells and commits forced cells until nothing changes.

optionExplanations: grid 记录每格当前确定到什么程度，是传播判断「这格已知」还是「仍待推」的基础。
行候选列表随着传播不断收缩，收缩到只剩一种时就能推出这一行的强制格。
列候选和行候选同理，两边互相过滤才是传播能级联推导的关键。
失败棋盘不需要记录，回溯栈本身就负责撤销和尝试下一分支，留着历史只会浪费内存。
optionExplanations_en: The grid tracks how determined each cell currently is, which is the base state propagation reads and updates.
Row candidate lists keep shrinking as propagation runs, and once only one layout remains, that row's forced cells drop out.
Column candidates work the same way, and it's this mutual filtering across both axes that drives the cascade.
Failed boards don't need to be kept — the recursion stack already handles undoing and trying the next branch, so history just wastes memory.

q: 补全候选过滤规则：
q_en: Complete the candidate-filtering rule:

q: 传播中的 overlap argument 指的是什么？
q_en: What does the overlap argument mean in propagation?
options: 任意两个 run 可以重叠
一条线剩余候选在某格值相同，该格就被强制为这个值
行和列 clue 可以互相覆盖删除
只要候选数量大于 1 就不能推出任何格子
options_en: Any two runs are allowed to overlap each other.
If a line's remaining candidates agree on one cell, that cell is forced to that value.
Row and column clues can cancel each other out.
As long as more than one candidate remains, no cell can ever be forced.
why: 某格在所有合法候选中都相同，说明无论最终选哪个候选，该格都必须是这个值。
why_en: The overlap argument marks a cell forced when every remaining layout for that line gives it the same value.

只要一条线剩下的每种候选在某格都给出同一个值，无论最终选哪个候选那格都必须是这个值。
行 clue 和列 clue 各自独立推导，谁也不能删除另一方，这个说法没有依据。

As long as every remaining candidate for a line agrees on one cell, that cell must take that value no matter which candidate ends up chosen.
Row and column clues are derived independently; neither one cancels the other, so this claim has no basis.
Even with more than one candidate left, some cells can still agree across all of them and still get forced.

没有任何格子能推出

Columns 1, 2, and 3 must be FILLED.
Every cell must be EMPTY.
No cell can be deduced at all.
why: 长度 4 的 run 只能从 0 或 1 开始，两种摆放都覆盖中间三格，因此这些格子是 forced filled。

optionExplanations: 格 0 和格 4 恰好是两种摆放里各自会变化的那两端，不是共同的部分。

Only two placements are legal, and whichever one you pick, cells 1, 2, and 3 end up filled either way, so they're forced FILLED.
The clue [4] requires one filled run of length 4, so the whole line being empty is impossible.
Both placements agree on the same value for the middle three cells — this is exactly what the overlap argument catches.

scenario: 你有一条 line 的当前已知格和该线当前剩余候选，需要过滤掉与已知格冲突的候选。
scenario_en: You have the current known cells for one line and its remaining candidates, and you need to filter out candidates that conflict with known cells.
q: 哪段代码表达了文章里的 `_filter_against`？
q_en: Which code snippet expresses the article's _filter_against logic?
options: [p for p in possibilities if all(line[i] == p[i] for i in range(len(line)))]
[p for p in possibilities if all(l == UNKNOWN or l == q for l, q in zip(line, p))]
[p for p in possibilities if p[0] == line[0] and p[-1] == line[-1]]
[p for p in possibilities if any(line[i] == p[i] for i in range(len(line)))]
options_en: Keep candidates that match the line at every position, UNKNOWN cells included.
Keep candidates that agree wherever the cell is known; UNKNOWN imposes nothing.
Keep candidates only when their first and last cell match, ignoring the middle.
Keep candidates that agree with the line in at least one position.
why: 候选只需要匹配已知格；UNKNOWN 位置不能要求候选等于 UNKNOWN。
why_en: Filtering keeps candidates that match every known cell and ignores unknown positions.
whenOtherWins: 如果 line 已经完整无 UNKNOWN，可以直接比较整条线的 run 是否等于 clue。
tradeoff: 逐位过滤已知格（准确但每轮要扫全候选）vs 只查首尾（快但漏检中间矛盾）
codeSample:
def _filter_against(possibilities, line):
    # UNKNOWN 位置不限制候选，已知格必须逐位相同
    return [p for p in possibilities
            if all(l == UNKNOWN or l == q
                   for l, q in zip(line, p))]
optionExplanations: UNKNOWN 不是一个具体状态，把它当成必须相等的固定值，会把每个候选都判成不匹配。
已知格必须逐位匹配，UNKNOWN 格不参与比较——正好对应候选过滤该有的语义。
只查首尾会漏掉中间任何位置的冲突，过滤形同虚设。
`any` 只要一处相同就放行，几乎所有候选都能活下来，候选表根本不会收缩。
optionExplanations_en: UNKNOWN isn't a concrete state; treating it as a fixed value to match wrongly rejects every candidate.
Known cells must match position by position while UNKNOWN cells impose no constraint — exactly what candidate filtering should do.
Checking only the endpoints misses any conflict in the middle, so the filter does nothing useful.
With any, a candidate survives by agreeing in just one position, so the list barely shrinks.

q_en: What does an empty candidate list mean after filtering a row or column in propagation?

当前已知格与该线 clue 互不兼容，分支应立即失败
可以先跳过这条线，稍后再随意回填
这说明该 clue 本身写错了，应当忽略它
options_en: The line is actually already solved, just not marked yet.
The known cells are incompatible with that line's clue, so the branch should fail immediately.
You can skip this line for now and fill it back in arbitrarily later.

why: 零候选说明没有任何合法线布局能满足当前已知状态；在搜索中这就是猜错后的快速矛盾。

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A contradiction is an empty candidate list showing the current branch cannot be valid.

optionExplanations: 候选为空说明没有任何合法排布，不是「已解出但没标记」，这两种状态完全不同。
候选列表空了，意味着没有任何合法布局能满足当前已知格，这个分支必须立即判失败。
跳过不检查会让矛盾状态被带进后续推导，之后更难定位问题。
candidate 为空是当前分支和已知格冲突，不代表 clue 本身有错，不该改题面。
optionExplanations_en: An empty candidate list means no valid layout exists, not that the line is solved without a marker — those are very different states.
An empty candidate list means no valid layout can satisfy the known cells anymore, so this branch must fail right away.
Skipping the check just carries the contradiction forward into later reasoning, making it harder to trace later.
An empty candidate list reflects a conflict with the current branch's known cells, not a wrong clue — the clue shouldn't be touched.

q: 把一次传播循环的核心步骤排成正确顺序：
q_en: Put the core steps of one propagation loop in the correct order:
steps: 过滤每条列候选，提交列中所有候选一致的格子
若某行或列候选为空，返回矛盾
过滤每条行候选，提交行中所有候选一致的格子
只要本轮填了新格，就继续下一轮
一整轮没有新格时停止传播
why: 行和列的顺序可以互换，关键是每轮过滤候选、发现 forced cell，并在没有变化时收敛。
why_en: Propagation repeatedly filters line candidates, commits forced cells, detects contradictions, and stops when a full pass makes no changes.
tradeoff: 跑到没有新格再停（信息榨干但每轮要扫全表）vs 一有新格就立刻回溯尝试（分支更早但推理不彻底）

flowchart LR
  Start[Start pass] --> Filter[Filter candidates]
  Filter --> Empty{any list empty}
  Empty -->|yes| Fail[contradiction]
  Empty -->|no| Force[derive forced cells]
  Force --> Changed{changed}
  Changed -->|yes| Start
  Changed -->|no| Done[fixed point]

q: 下一步应该怎么做？
q_en: What should the solver do next?
options: 直接把当前半成品 grid 当作最终答案返回
挑一个 UNKNOWN 格猜状态，再重新传播
清空所有候选列表，从头重新生成一遍
从此以后完全忽略列 clue 只看行 clue
options_en: Return the current half-filled grid as the final answer.
Guess a state for one UNKNOWN cell, then propagate again.
Clear every candidate list and regenerate everything from scratch.
Ignore column clues from now on and rely on row clues only.
why: 传播不能解决局部歧义时，回溯负责试探；每个猜测后再传播能让错误分支快速产生矛盾。
why_en: When propagation stalls, the solver guesses an unknown cell and runs propagation again so wrong guesses fail quickly.
whenOtherWins: 如果传播已填满所有格子，只需要验证 solved，不必再猜。
tradeoff: 猜测后重新传播（错误分支快速矛盾）vs 直接暴力搜完剩余格子（不利用已推出的约束）

flowchart TD

  Unknown -->|no| Solved[check solved]

  Guess --> Filled[assume filled]

候选内容并没有变化，重新生成只是白白重复一遍计算。
丢掉列 clue 会让能推出的格子少一半，传播能力直接大幅削弱。
optionExplanations_en: The grid still has UNKNOWN cells; the requirement is to return a full solution or null, not a half-finished grid.
When propagation stalls it's just local ambiguity — guessing one UNKNOWN cell's state and re-propagating right after quickly confirms whether that guess holds.
Nothing about the candidates has changed, so regenerating them just repeats the same computation for nothing.
Dropping column clues removes half the cells propagation could otherwise force, sharply weakening it.

q: 哪段 clone 写法能避免候选列表共享 bug？
q_en: Which clone implementation avoids the shared-candidate-list bug?
options: np = puzzle; nrp = row_poss; ncp = col_poss
np = puzzle.clone(); nrp, ncp = deepcopy(row_poss), deepcopy(col_poss)
np = puzzle.clone(); nrp = row_poss; ncp = col_poss
np = puzzle.clone(); nrp = row_poss.copy(); ncp = col_poss.copy()
options_en: Reuse the same puzzle and candidate lists with no copying at all.
Clone the grid and deep-copy both candidate structures for the child branch.
Clone the puzzle grid but keep sharing the same row and column candidate lists.
Clone the grid and copy the outer candidate lists, leaving the inner lists shared.
why: grid 和每条线的候选列表都要复制；只复制 grid 仍会让传播共享并修改父分支的候选列表。
why_en: A search branch needs independent copies of both the puzzle grid and every row and column candidate list.
whenOtherWins: 如果数据结构是持久化不可变结构，可以共享旧版本并返回新版本；普通 list 不能这样共享。
tradeoff: 深拷贝 grid+候选列表（安全但多花内存和时间）vs 共享引用（省内存但会互相污染）

from copy import deepcopy
np = puzzle.clone()                                # 复制棋盘
nrp, ncp = deepcopy(row_poss), deepcopy(col_poss)  # 每行/每列候选各自独立
np.set_cell(r, c, state)
result = _search(np, nrp, ncp)
optionExplanations: 两个分支引用同一份状态，一个分支改了格子，另一个分支的棋盘也会跟着变。
grid 用 clone 复制，row_poss/col_poss 做深拷贝，两个分支从此互不干扰。
只复制了棋盘，候选列表还是同一批对象，传播过滤照样会跨分支污染。
`row_poss.copy()` 只拷贝外层容器，内层每行的候选列表仍是共享对象，污染没解决。
optionExplanations_en: Both branches reference the same state, so setting a cell in one branch changes the board the other branch sees too.
Cloning the grid and deep-copying both candidate structures is what makes the two branches fully isolated.
Only the board gets cloned; the candidate lists are still the same objects, so filtering in one branch still corrupts the other.
row_poss.copy() only copies the outer container — each inner per-row candidate list is still shared, so the corruption bug remains.

Returning false when a run exceeds the clue's length.
Doing a final extract_runs comparison once the column is complete.

全 EMPTY grid
全 FILLED grid
null/None

An all-EMPTY grid.
An all-FILLED grid.
null / None.
why: 题目要求无解时返回空结果；传播或搜索最终会让所有分支矛盾并返回 None。
why_en: If no grid satisfies all clues, every branch fails and the solver returns null.

确实无解时每个分支都会矛盾收场，solver 该老实返回 null 而不是硬凑一个假答案。

An all-EMPTY grid is only valid if every clue is [0]; it isn't a default fallback for unsolvable puzzles.
An all-FILLED grid still has to satisfy every clue, so it violates the constraints just as much when unsolvable.
When truly unsolvable, every branch ends in contradiction, so the solver should honestly return null instead of faking an answer.

q: 文章建议遇到类似约束题时先问哪些问题？（多选）
q_en: What questions does the article suggest asking for similar constraint problems? (Choose all that apply.)
options: 输入是否有来自多个轴的约束
是否能便宜地枚举每条线的合法选项
固定一条线是否会明显约束另一条线
是否可以忽略所有局部矛盾
options_en: Does the input carry constraints from more than one axis?
Can you enumerate each line's valid options cheaply?
Does fixing one line meaningfully constrain another?
Can you just ignore every local contradiction?
why: 如果多轴约束、候选可枚举、交叉影响强，传播通常比直接搜索更值得优先写。
why_en: Propagation is attractive when constraints come from multiple axes, line options are enumerable, and fixing one line constrains another.

termDefinitions.meaning: 约束满足问题：给一组变量赋值，同时满足多条约束。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CSP, a constraint satisfaction problem, assigns values to variables so every constraint holds at once.

optionExplanations: 只有单轴约束时传播收益有限，先确认是不是真的存在多个方向的约束再决定要不要上传播。
如果一条线的合法候选枚举起来很贵，传播的过滤成本也会跟着变贵，这一点值得先算一算。

局部矛盾恰恰是分支该立即失败的信号，忽略它只会让错误分支继续往下算，浪费时间。
optionExplanations_en: Propagation helps less with only one axis of constraints, so it's worth confirming multiple directions actually constrain the puzzle first.
If enumerating a line's valid candidates is expensive, propagation's filtering cost gets expensive too — worth estimating up front.
If fixing one line barely constrains another, the cascade won't force many cells, which weakens propagation's payoff.
A local contradiction is exactly the signal a branch should fail immediately — ignoring it just lets a doomed branch keep computing.

q: 最好的回答是什么？
q_en: What is the best answer?
options: 因为给行排序一定能把 NP-hard 问题变成 O(n)
因为 row-by-row 在所有 15×15 题目上都已经足够快
因为列 clue 其实是多余的，完全可以删除
列 clue 和行 clue 一样强，只当拒绝器浪费了一半信息，该让它主动传播
options_en: Because sorting rows can turn an NP-hard problem into O(n).
Because row-by-row is already fast enough on every 15 by 15 puzzle.
Because column clues are actually redundant and can be deleted.
Column clues carry just as much signal as row clues; using them only as a rejector wastes half the information — they should actively propagate.
why: row_bt 的问题不是单纯顺序不好，而是没有把列约束用来推导格子；传播把两轴信息都前置使用。
why_en: The key is that columns are not just validators; they should actively shrink possibilities and force cells.
whenOtherWins: 如果列约束非常弱或题目只要求小规模，row-by-row 加简单剪枝也可能足够。
tradeoff: 把列约束当主动推导源（传播，更快但要维护候选状态）vs 把列约束只当事后过滤器（row backtracking，简单但慢）
optionExplanations: 给行排序只是换尝试顺序，不会改变问题本身的复杂度类别。
benchmark 明明白白显示 row_bt 在 15×15 要 68000ms，早就超出预算了。
删掉列约束会让候选过滤少一半信息来源，传播能力直接打对折。
row-by-row 把列约束只当成事后拒绝器，等于浪费了一半推导信息；该让它加入传播，两轴一起收缩候选。
optionExplanations_en: Sorting rows only changes try order; it doesn't change the problem's underlying complexity class.
The benchmark clearly shows row_bt takes about 68000ms at 15 by 15, well past the budget.
Dropping column constraints removes half the information candidate filtering relies on, cutting propagation's power in half.
Row-by-row treats column clues as a mere after-the-fact filter, throwing away half the deductive power — folding them into propagation lets both axes shrink candidates together.

所有 Nonogram 都能纯传播解出
fallback search 是为了打乱输出
传播只能推出逻辑强制格，遇到局部歧义时必须尝试假设
options_en: Propagation never fills in any cell at all.
Every nonogram can be solved by pure propagation alone.
Fallback search exists just to shuffle the output.
Propagation only derives logically forced cells, so local ambiguity still requires a guess.
why: 传播是局部推理，不保证消除所有歧义；搜索负责处理需要假设才能推进的分支。
why_en: Propagation handles forced deductions, but ambiguous puzzles can still require guesses and backtracking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 反复用已知格过滤各线候选、推出强制格，直到没有新变化。

optionExplanations: 传播恰恰能填出大量强制格，这是它比暴力搜索快的核心原因，这个说法完全相反。
如果所有题都能纯传播解出，benchmark 里就不需要区分 propagate_bt 和 fallback 分支了。
fallback search 是为了在传播卡住时继续推进，不是随便打乱结果。
传播只能确认「无论哪个候选都一样」的格子，遇到多个候选并存的歧义就推不动了，只能靠假设分支去试。
optionExplanations_en: Propagation is exactly what fills in large numbers of forced cells — that's why it beats brute search, so this claim is backwards.
If pure propagation solved every puzzle, there'd be no need to distinguish a fallback branch in the benchmark at all.
Fallback search exists to keep making progress when propagation stalls, not to scramble the result.
Propagation can only confirm cells where every remaining candidate agrees; once genuine ambiguity remains, it stalls and needs a guessed branch to move forward.

Using recursion means you never need candidate lists.

Find propagable structure first so deduction shrinks the search tree.

optionExplanations: 文章正是从暴力搜索一路升级出去的，逐格搜索恰恰是被替代的起点而不是终点建议。
递归和要不要维护候选列表是两回事，propagation 版本照样递归还要维护候选。

Recursion and maintaining candidate lists are separate concerns; the propagation version still recurses and still keeps candidates.
Column information can shrink candidates as you go; saving it only for a final check throws away a lot of early deduction.
From per-cell brute force to row candidates to two-axis propagation, the core lesson is to find where deduction applies first so constraints shrink the search tree instead of just waiting on search.

q: solver 为什么一开始就把传入的 puzzle 克隆一份再工作？

options: 让失败搜索只弄脏副本，不污染调用者原始 grid
克隆时顺便把 clue 编译成候选填法列表
副本对象比原对象读写都更快一些
防止多线程并发写同一个 grid 时发生数据竞争和撕裂
options_en: So a failed search only dirties the copy, never the caller's original grid.
Cloning also compiles the clues into candidate fills along the way.
The copy is somewhat faster to read and write than the original.
To stop concurrent threads racing and tearing the same grid.
optionExplanations: solver 反复试填再回退，直接改原 grid 会在失败路径上留下半成品；副本把这些脏状态隔离在调用者之外。
clone 只复制 grid 的格子状态，候选列表是另外单独 generate 出来的，两件事不相干。
读副本不会比原对象更快，性能从来不是这次 clone 的动机。
这份 solver 是单线程递归搜索，clone 防的是自我污染，而不是并发竞争。
optionExplanations_en: The solver guesses and backtracks repeatedly, so writing the original grid would leave half-filled state on failure; the copy isolates that from the caller.
Clone only copies cell state; the candidate lists are generated separately, so this is unrelated.
Reading the copy is not faster than the original; performance was never the reason to clone.
This solver is single-threaded recursion — clone guards against self-pollution, not concurrency.
why: solver 是破坏性的反复试填，clone 用一份可丢弃的副本换来调用者输入的不可变；代价是多一份 O(r·c) 的内存拷贝。
why_en: The solver mutates the grid as it guesses and backtracks, so it works on a throwaway clone to keep the caller's input intact — at the cost of one extra O(r·c) copy.

scenario: cell-by-cell 版只在填完某行最后一格时才比对该行 runs 与 clue，中途每填一格并不检查。
scenario_en: The cell-by-cell version compares a row's runs against its clue only when the row's last cell is set, not after each cell mid-row.
q: 为什么行内中途不比对 runs 是否等于 clue？
q_en: Why not compare a row's runs against its clue midway through the row?
options: 部分填的行 runs 本就不必等于 clue，中途比对没意义
中途检查会顺手修改格子状态，破坏之后回溯的 UNKNOWN 恢复
extract_runs 只能沿列方向提取，行方向算不出来
clue 会在填充过程中被动态改写，比不了
options_en: A partly filled row's runs need not equal the clue yet, so a mid-row check is pointless.
A mid-row check would mutate cell state and break the later UNKNOWN restore on backtrack.
extract_runs can only read along columns, not rows.
The clue is rewritten dynamically while filling, so it can't be compared.
optionExplanations: 行没填完时这一行的 runs 属于中间状态，可以暂时不匹配 clue；填满整行那一刻的比对才真正判定违规。
extract_runs 只是读当前行的值来算 runs，并不写格子；状态恢复由 unwind 的 set UNKNOWN 负责，与检查无关。
行和列的 runs 都能算，方向从来不是限制；问题出在检查的时机而非轴向。
clue 是题目给定的固定输入，全程不会变，动态改写的说法不成立。
optionExplanations_en: Before a row is full its runs are only a prefix and may legitimately differ from the clue; only at the last cell does a mismatch mean a real violation.
extract_runs just reads the row to compute runs; it never writes cells, and restoring UNKNOWN is unwind's job, not the check's.
extract_runs works on both rows and columns; the issue is timing, not axis.
The clue is a fixed given input that never changes, so it is never rewritten.
why: 行没填满前 runs 只是前缀、允许不等于 clue；把行检查放到行末，是在第一个能确定违规的时刻剪枝，省掉中途注定不匹配的无效比对。
why_en: A partial row's runs are only a prefix and may differ from the clue, so the row check runs at the last cell — the first moment a mismatch is real — and skips wasted mid-line comparisons.

scenario: cell-by-cell 版把整个棋盘存在一个 r 行 c 列的 grid 里，并按格子顺序逐格递归下探。
scenario_en: The cell-by-cell version stores the whole board in one r-by-c grid and recurses cell by cell in order.
q: 补全 cell-by-cell 的空间复杂度：
q_en: Complete the space complexity of cell-by-cell backtracking:
text: grid 本身占 {{O(r·c)}}，递归栈深度等于已下探的格子数所以也是 {{O(r·c)}}，合计 {{O(r·c)}} 的多项式空间——远小于 2^(r·c) 的时间。
why: 空间 = grid 存储 O(r·c) + 递归调用栈 O(r·c)；r=行数、c=列数、栈深等于已探格子数 r·c。它是多项式空间，说明 cell-by-cell 的真正瓶颈只在指数时间，不在内存。
why_en: Space is O(r times c) for the grid plus O(r times c) for the recursion stack, so memory is only polynomial — the real bottleneck is the exponential time, not space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录尚未返回的递归调用的栈；深度等于当前下探的层数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The recursion stack holds the not-yet-returned recursive calls; its depth equals how deep the search has descended.

termDefinitions.meaning: 存棋盘每个格子状态的 r×c 二维数组。

scenario: row-by-row 回溯每行选一个候选 fill、共 r 行，搜索树最多 P^r 个叶子；到达一个叶子后还要验证全部列。
scenario_en: Row-by-row backtracking picks one candidate fill per row over r rows, up to P^r leaves; at each leaf it still verifies all columns.
q: 除了 P^r 个叶子，row-by-row 每个叶子还要额外付出多少代价？
q_en: Beyond P^r leaves, what extra cost does row-by-row pay per leaf?
options: O(r·c) 的整盘列扫描
O(1) 的常数级检查
O(P) 重新枚举该行候选
额外再乘上一个 2^c 的因子
options_en: An O(r·c) scan of the whole board's columns.
An O(1) constant-time check.
An O(P) re-enumeration of that row's candidates.
One more 2^c multiplicative factor.
optionExplanations: 每落一个叶子都要逐列重算 runs 检查一致性，扫过 r×c 个格子，所以真实上界是 P^r 个叶子乘以每叶 O(r·c)。
列一致性检查要遍历整盘格子，不是常数级；把它当 O(1) 会低估总代价。
候选是开局一次性 generate 好的，叶子处只做列扫描，不会再重新枚举行候选。
列扫描是线性 O(r·c) 而非再套一层 2^c；2^c 是 cell-by-cell 的量级，用错了方案。
optionExplanations_en: Each leaf rescans every column to recompute runs, walking r×c cells, so the real bound is P^r leaves times O(r·c) per leaf.
The column-consistency check walks the whole board, not a constant; calling it O(1) underestimates the cost.
Candidates are generated once up front; a leaf only scans columns, it never re-enumerates row candidates.
The column scan is linear O(r·c), not another 2^c factor; 2^c belongs to cell-by-cell, the wrong solver here.
why: 叶子数是 P^r（P=每行平均合法候选数、r=行数），但每到一个叶子都要 O(r·c) 地扫全部列验证一致性；总代价是 P^r × O(r·c)，别只数叶子忘了每叶的列扫描。
why_en: Leaves number P^r, but each leaf costs O(r·c) to scan every column for consistency, so the real total is P^r times O(r·c) — don't count leaves and forget the per-leaf column scan.

scenario: 传播反复扫全盘：每次 pass 过滤候选并提交所有被强制的格子，直到某次 pass 没有新格被固定才停。
scenario_en: Propagation repeatedly scans the whole grid: each pass filters candidates and commits every forced cell, stopping when a pass fixes no new cell.
q: 凭什么保证这个传播循环一定会终止？
q_en: What guarantees this propagation loop terminates?
options: 每次有效 pass 至少固定一格，格子有限，故最多 rows×cols 轮
因为每次 pass 一定恰好固定一格不多不少，跑满整盘格子数那么多轮之后必然停下
循环里有显式计数器，到上限就强制退出
候选列表只增不减，最终收敛到唯一解
options_en: Each effective pass fixes at least one cell, and cells are finite, so at most rows×cols passes.
Each pass fixes exactly one cell, so it stops after as many passes as there are cells on the board.
An explicit counter in the loop forces an exit at its limit.
Candidate lists only grow, converging to a unique solution.
optionExplanations: 只要一次 pass 还在提交新格，它至少推进一格；能提交新格的轮数被有限的格子数卡住，无新格时循环退出。
一次 pass 可能一口气固定多格，也可能一格都固定不了就触发退出；不是恰好一格。
代码没有硬编码计数器，靠的是 changed 标志：本轮没有新格被固定就停，不是数到某个上限。
候选列表是被 filter 越过滤越短，不是只增不减；把方向记反了。
optionExplanations_en: As long as a pass commits a new cell it advances by at least one; the number of such passes is capped by the finite cell count, and the loop exits when none change.
A single pass may fix several cells at once, or zero (which triggers the exit); it is not exactly one per pass.
There is no hard-coded counter; the changed flag stops the loop when a pass fixes no new cell, not at some limit.
Filtering makes candidate lists shrink, not grow; this reverses the direction.
why: 终止性靠单调进度：每次有效 pass 至少把一个 UNKNOWN 格固定成确定值，而格子总数 rows×cols 有限，所以固定新格的 pass 最多 rows×cols 次，之后必有一次 pass 无变化并退出。
why_en: Each effective pass fixes at least one UNKNOWN cell and cells are finite at rows×cols, so at most rows×cols passes make progress before one changes nothing and the loop stops.

scenario_en: Each propagation pass filters every line once, dropping candidates that no longer match the known cells; as candidates shrink, later passes get cheaper.
q: 补全单次传播 pass 的成本量级：
q_en: Complete the cost of a single propagation pass:
text: 一次 pass 的成本 ≈ {{所有线剩余候选数之和}} 的线性量（每个候选按其线长各测一次），所以候选越少后面的 pass {{越便宜}}。
why: 单 pass 成本 ≈ Σ(每条线的剩余候选数)，每个候选沿其线长各扫一次；这是算术不是搜索。用途：它解释了为什么传播随候选收缩越跑越快，而 P^r 的搜索每层都指数膨胀。
why_en: A pass costs about the sum of remaining candidates across all lines, since each is tested once along its line; that's arithmetic, so passes get cheaper as candidates shrink.

scenario: 传播+回退能在毫秒级解掉测试里的 25×25，但 Nonogram 判定本身是 NP-complete。
scenario_en: Propagation plus fallback solves the test suite's 25x25 in milliseconds, yet deciding a Nonogram is itself NP-complete.
q: 既然 Nonogram 是 NP-complete，传播到底改变了什么？
q_en: Given Nonogram is NP-complete, what does propagation actually change?
options: 只改善真实 puzzle 的实际表现，最坏复杂度仍是指数
把最坏复杂度从指数降到多项式，问题不再是 NP-complete
让 solver 对所有可能输入都保证毫秒返回
证明了 Nonogram 其实属于 P
options_en: It only improves real puzzles' practical runtime; the worst case stays exponential.
It lowers the worst case from exponential to polynomial, so it's no longer NP-complete.
It guarantees a millisecond return on every possible input.
It proves Nonogram actually lies in P.
optionExplanations: 传播把人类的 overlap 推理机械化，让设计良好的真实 puzzle 大多不靠搜索就解出；但对抗性最坏输入仍可能逼出指数级回退。
最坏复杂度是问题固有的属性，任何算法都改不了它；传播只挪动了实际耗时，不动复杂度类。
对刻意构造的最坏 puzzle，propagation 收敛后仍剩大量歧义，回退可能指数级展开，不存在全输入的毫秒保证。
除非 P=NP，否则没人能把 NP-complete 问题证进 P；一个快解法不构成这种证明。
optionExplanations_en: Propagation mechanizes the human overlap deduction so well-formed real puzzles mostly solve without search, but adversarial worst cases can still force exponential fallback.
NP-completeness is the problem's inherent hardness; no algorithm changes the worst-case bound — propagation shifts real runtime, not the complexity class.
On a crafted worst-case puzzle, ambiguity remains after propagation and fallback can expand exponentially; there is no all-inputs millisecond guarantee.
Short of P=NP, no one proves an NP-complete problem into P; a fast solver is not such a proof.
why: NP-complete 是问题的固有最坏难度，传播这类启发式改不了它；它改的是真实、良构 puzzle 的平均表现——多数格子靠演绎定下、搜索只收尾。代价：遇到对抗性输入仍会退化成指数搜索。
why_en: Propagation can't change the NP-complete worst case; it only speeds up real, well-formed puzzles where deduction fixes most cells, while adversarial inputs still fall back to exponential search.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: NP-complete (Nondeterministic Polynomial-time complete) is a class of decision problems with no known worst-case polynomial algorithm.

termDefinitions.meaning: 若一条线所有合法候选在某格取值一致，该格就被强制成那个值——人类解谜时的推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The overlap argument: if every valid candidate for a line agrees on a cell, that cell is forced to that value.
